en.headline: Cultural Centre moonlit lanterns stay lit through 11 October
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department's free piazza installation by Stickyline lights from 6:30pm to 11pm, Thursdays to Sundays.
body: A Mid-Autumn lighting installation remains on the Hong Kong Cultural Centre piazza in Tsim Sha Tsui through Sunday 11 October, after the Victoria Park lantern display ends this weekend. The Community Programmes Office of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department lists the piece for Thursdays to Sundays from 17 September to 11 October.

The installation, titled Moonlit Bunny Crew, is designed and produced by the local team Stickyline. The office said it sets a miniature Hong Kong of the 18 districts in simplified geometric forms, with rabbit figures posed as a film crew carrying cameras and lights. Admission is free. Lights are on from 6:30pm to 11pm; they were extended to midnight only from 24 to 27 September.

The same office's Mid-Autumn lantern carnival at Victoria Park runs on a shorter calendar, through 7 October, with lighting in the same evening window. The Cultural Centre display is a separate programme and does not include the park's market stalls.
The office said programme details can change without notice. On Golden Week Sunday the piazza lights again at 6:30pm.

zh.headline: 文化中心中秋光影裝置展至10月11日
zh.dek: 康文署社區節目辦事處表示，尖沙咀文化中心露天廣場裝置周四至日晚上6時半至11時亮燈，免費入場。
body: 尖沙咀香港文化中心露天廣場的中秋光影裝置，會續展至10月11日周日，較維園綵燈會的展期更長。康樂及文化事務署社區節目辦事處列出，裝置由9月17日至10月11日、周四至日展出。
裝置名為「月下兔仔攝製隊」，由本地團隊Stickyline設計及製作。辦事處表示，作品以簡化幾何造型砌出十八區地標，並配以拿相機、提燈光的兔子造型，像一支在拍攝香港的攝製隊。入場免費，亮燈時間為晚上6時半至11時；只有9月24日至27日曾延長至午夜。
同一辦事處的維園中秋綵燈會則展至10月7日，亮燈時段相若。文化中心這組是另一項節目，並不包括維園的市集攤檔。
辦事處表示，節目內容可能在不另通知下更改。國慶假期這個周日，廣場晚上6時半再亮燈。
